content_html:
SEO vs AEO vs GEO vs AIO: A Decision Table by Business Type

The SEO, AEO, GEO difference, plus AIO, in one line each: SEO wins rankings on search results pages, AEO wins the direct answer in snippets and voice replies, GEO wins mentions and citations inside AI-generated answers, and AIO makes the whole site easy for AI systems to crawl, read and trust. They stack on top of each other, so most businesses need a mix rather than a choice.

The four layers explained

SEO (search engine optimization) is the base. It covers crawling, indexing, content, links and page experience. Without it, the other three struggle.

AEO (answer engine optimization) sits on top of SEO. It shapes pages so engines can quote a short answer. See what AEO is for detail.

GEO (generative engine optimization) reaches beyond your site. It builds the brand signals AI tools use when they write answers. Read what GEO is for the full picture.

AIO (AI optimization) supports all of them. It covers AI crawler access, clean HTML, structured data and agent readiness. Our glossary on what AIO is explains both meanings of the term.

SEO vs AEO vs GEO vs AIO at a glance

LayerTargetMain workKey metric
SEOSearch rankingsContent, links, technical healthClicks and conversions
AEODirect answersAnswer-first writing, FAQs, structureSnippets won
GEOAI answer mentionsMentions, entities, original dataPrompt mention rate
AIOAI system accessCrawlers, schema, rendering, agentsPages readable by AI bots

Decision table by business type

BusinessStart withThen addWhy
Local shop or clinicSEO and local SEOAEO for local FAQsMaps and voice drive most leads
Ecommerce storeSEO and AIOAEO for product questionsCrawlable product data matters most
B2B servicesSEO and AEOGEOBuyers research in AI tools
Software or SaaSSEO and GEOAIO for docs and agentsComparisons happen in chat
Publisher or blogSEO and AEOGEO through original dataCitations replace some clicks

How the SEO, AEO, GEO difference plays out in practice

Take one page: "How much does a website cost in India?". SEO makes it rank. AEO puts a clear price range in the first lines so Google can show it as a snippet. GEO earns mentions of your brand in articles and forums about website costs. Meanwhile, AIO makes sure AI crawlers can fetch the page and read the price table in plain HTML.

So one topic touches all four layers. That is why splitting them into separate projects wastes effort.

Common mistakes

  • Chasing GEO tactics while key pages are not indexed.
  • Adding FAQ blocks everywhere and calling it AEO.
  • Blocking all AI crawlers by default, then wondering why AI tools ignore you.
  • Reporting each layer separately, so nobody sees the full picture.

One plan for all four

Once you see the SEO, AEO, GEO difference clearly, start with a single audit that checks rankings, answer readiness, AI mentions and crawler access together. Our SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO audit does exactly that. Then plan the work in one roadmap, as our GEO framework shows. For the AEO versus GEO detail, read AEO vs GEO.

Google's own SEO starter guide remains the best base for every layer. If you want one team to run all four, our GEO service works alongside our SEO, AEO and AIO teams.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO?

SEO wins rankings, AEO wins direct answers, GEO wins mentions in AI-generated answers and AIO makes the whole site easy for AI systems to read and trust.

Which one should a small business start with?

Start with SEO and local SEO, then add AEO to the pages that rank. GEO and AIO follow once the basics are in place.

Do I need four separate agencies?

No. The four overlap heavily, so one team with a single plan usually works better than four separate projects.
